blocks.text:
The CSS
background-clip property
defines how far the background (color, image, or gradient) should extend within
an element.
This property can have one of the following values:

items: border-box - The background extends behind the border. This is default
padding-box - The background extends to the inside edge of the border
content-box - The background extends to the edge of the content box
